environment.configuration: Debug/OFF, GCC with -g1, CLI/layer/tests and SPIR-V validation ON, real runtime layer tests OFF

findings.description: The exact Debug/OFF full CTest run passed 312 of 315. All three failures invoke the same legacy success-output assertion, whose broad case-insensitive regex misreads zero-valued failure fields in the successful new INFO summary. The summary independently recorded three creations, no failure outcomes and no unknowns, and the child exited successfully.

summary: Added a private ledger for stable selected pipeline identities and unsampled ITEM frames for both controllers. Recoverable scheduler cursors remain distinct from terminal facts, with exact assignment/hash validation, compact per-item history, explicit conflict and discovery uncertainty, and a one-line final summary.

R21-bounded-state.assertions: 105,000 keys with exact backing-store accounting, deterministic stale/out-of-order duplicates, codec and omission controls, matching distributions with capped warning collection enabled or disabled.

R21-production-ordering.assertions: Real null-device call traces and real controller. Crash at index 10 creates 1..9 and 11..20, retries [11,21), marks 10 skipped and 0 unknown with nonzero status. Dependency crash with borrowed index retries [1,21) without an attributed selected culprit. Paired clean case creates 21 selected and the dependency.

R21-reconciliation-properties.assertions: 5,040 permutations with four duplicate subsets per permutation, independent terminal oracle, tag/hash/worker/range validation, conflict and stale failure history, and strict codec resynchronization.

R21-regression-sensitivity.assertions: The unmodified ordering-clean test passed in both the focused and full Debug/OFF inventories. The coordinator built an isolated Release/OFF mutation that drops creation publication while leaving FINAL intact. Its targeted CTest returned nonzero and printed the intended R21/ordering/selected-outcome-oracle assertion.

R21-retry-and-evidence-loss.assertions: Actual retry ranges and previous terminal failure retained, clean FINAL and native zero require item facts, hard loss/truncation preserves only received facts, full sibling evidence survives either harvest order, setup failure leaves known selection unknown.

R21-selected-boundary-and-outcomes.assertions: Exact per-item creation, read, parse, support, dependency, validation, VkResult and setup outcomes, first-success/later-failure loop, no-execution status, actual compatible hint skip, required incomplete and accepted recovered scope, equal hashes across tags, composite duplicates, extra library role, and ordinary, quiet and progress controller paths.

verification_limits: Native Windows execution explicitly waived. Paired Windows code was inspected.
CPU and synthetic null-device verification provide no Vulkan hardware, driver cache, persistence or Steam-runtime evidence.
Release/OFF, Release/ON and ASan+UBSan are coordinated independently at the exact candidate. No pass is claimed here for checks without a complete receipt.
Existing --progress logging suppression applies to the master summary. Direct master and --quiet-slave retain the summary.
Zero benchmark iterations are classified as no execution where the missing shader handle is caused by policy, while the prior aggregate status remains intact.
No full-matrix pass is claimed for this committed candidate. The exact Debug/OFF check exposed the three compatibility regression failures above.
Parent-queue execution is accounted as a dependency. If existing scheduling suppresses a distinct selected dispatch of the same key, its selected result remains unknown.
